fields.name: CHALLENGE HEADLINE
fields.description: Use a short sentence, easy to remember, descriptive of the problem to solve
examples: For [market/country/region and use case], what [startups/scaleups/OEM/integrators] offer [technology/solution] that [achieves result/measurable KPI] complying with [regulation/standard/constraint], with [minimum TRL], suitable for pilot in [months] and operational in [geography]?

fields.name: PROBLEM
fields.description: Explain briefly relevant background information, detailing the problem we are trying to solve and why
examples: Background
Problem

Expected impact and benefits of solving the problem (cost savings, efficiency, new revenue streams, customer experience, etc.). Include business case or indicative figures of this benefits if available
Would other business units benefit of the solution of this problem? Would other business units be interested in the solution for other purposes?

fields.name: POTENTIAL SOLUTION/S
fields.description: On your best knowledge, describe possible solutions and/or technologies that you estimate could solve the problem. Include names of known companies and startups that may have a solutions and/or you have been in contact in the past
examples: Possible solutions/technologies. Company names (if known)
Functional description of the potential solution
Technical specifications (if known)

fields.name: DISCARDED SOLUTIONS
fields.description: Indicate which solutions you think are not viable and why. Indicate the name of companies owing the solution if possible.
examples: Non-viable solutions. Company name (if known)
Why?

fields.name: NUMBER OF STARTUPS
fields.description: Indicate the number of potential startups expected to review. The first deliverable will be a list of startups potentially qualified to solve the Challenge, based on public information (Long List). The team will review and select a few, to be contacted by Repsol to request further information and confirm their qualification and interest in meeting Repsol (Short List).
examples: Expected number of startups in the Long List: 20
Expected number of Startups in the Short List: 3 to 5

fields.name: CONSIDERATIONS
fields.description: Are there a time, cost, resources or technology constraints to consider for this project? What is the level of urgency or deadlines? What are the main barriers or stoppers to consider? (availability of the team, engagement of the end users, etc.)?

fields.name: PILOT PROJECT/PROOF OF CONCEPT
fields.description: The Pilot Project or Proof of Concept is a project of limited scope and timing to qualify the selected startup and its solution. Please confirm the interest in such project and detail preliminary particulars, if known. If the objective of this challenge is to obtain a list of startups only, indicate so, together with the number of expected Startups.
examples: Scope/Use Case (specific functionalities, data sets, in a certain geography, department, etc.):
Technical or other relevant particulars to consider:
People Involved (name and position):
Potential Start date:
Estimate duration:
Budget (in case we estimate the startup will incur in costs, indicate if you are willing to pay for the Pilot Project/Proof of Concept):
fields.response: [Escribir aquí los detalles del proyecto piloto]

fields.name: VALUE PROPOSITION/POST-PILOT COLLABORATION
fields.description: What are the benefits that the startup may get if it accepts to collaborate with Repsol, if the Pilot Project/Proof of Concept is successful. Please elaborate
examples: Commercial Collaboration in the short term
Access to Repsol clients or markets
Long term Partnership
Collaboration in a joint R&D project
Financing

fields.name: REPSOL TEAM
fields.description: Indicate the people involved, name and position
examples: Sponsor
Owner (main contact person)
Coordinator (support to the Owner, if applicable)
Evaluators (people involved in reviewing Long List and Short List)
Pilot Project/Proof of Concept Team

fields.name: DOCUMENTATION
fields.description: Please list and send enclosed any relevant documentation you estimate useful
